{{Top|leg}}
'''The Nose''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that could be attached to the back of a [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]]. It would blink red and orange if it "sniffed" anything.

[[Galactic Alliance Guard]]s had them attached to the backs of their left gauntlets and used them during their raids, starting with their [[Raid on Jabi Town|raid]] on [[Jabi Town]].
